          Core and Coil Data Sheet - Rev B


Synthetic composite core/coil datasheet. Approved project change records may supersede catalog values.

1. Core and geometry

 Property                               Released value                           Legacy/catalog value
 Core material                                 Linear benchmark iron                                 -
 Effective mu_r                          1200                                  1000 in catalog Rev A
 Cross-section                           25 mm x 25 mm                       same
 Nominal air gap                             1.50 mm                            same
 As-built prototype gap                       1.58 mm                                           test configuration only

2. Exciting coil

 Property                                   Value
 Turns                                     600
 Reference frequency                         50 Hz
 Current definition                     RMS phasor magnitude
 Final benchmark current                          2.0 A RMS
 Polarity                                             Positive current -> positive mmf

3. Measuring coil

 Property                               Released value                            Old prototype note
 Turns                                 50                                       40
 Location                                      Air-gap region                           same
 Induced-voltage orientation                  Negative relative to useful flux arrow               not frozen
